actions.contentful_record_create.descrip: Creates a new Contentful record for a given Content Model
actions.contentful_record_create.props.p: Whether or not to publish this record after creating it.
actions.contentful_record_get.descriptio: Gets a Contentful record for a given Content Model
actions.contentful_record_get.props.enti: The ID of the record to get.
actions.contentful_record_search.descrip: Searches for records of a given Content Model
actions.contentful_record_search.props.i: Number of levels to include for entries and assets. See https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/references/content-delivery-api/#/reference/resource-links/retrieval-of-linked-resource-links
actions.contentful_record_search.props.l: The maximum number of records to return
actions.contentful_record_search.props.q: The query formula to use to search for records. See https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/references/content-delivery-api/#/reference/search-parameters for more information
actions.contentful_record_search.props.s: The fields to return for each record.
The number of records to skip
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
